rows.name: Letitia Cooper
rows.comment: She painted a dog portrait for my sister in law's birthday of her two Yorkies who had passed away.  The painting was so life like you could clearly see who was who in this portrait.  Jennefers work is beyond excellent and she puts everything into each one.

rows.name: Susan Morgan
rows.comment: Jennefer did an amazing job painting my donkey as a birthday present for my daughter, who named her because she was born on my daughter’s birthday 🎂 The painting looked just like her and so real!!!

rows.name: Janice Jordan
rows.comment: I love the painting of my dog Max …Would highly recommend Jennifer if you want a beautiful painting done ….⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

rows.name: Norma JC
rows.comment: The most excellent vision, capturing essence and character of commissioned artwork. So talented.
